payload.title: Newsroom runtime ignores the selected publication root during attachment hydration
payload.description:
The newsroom runtime hard-codes its shared code checkout as PAPYRUS_ROOT, ignoring the explicit publication root already supported by papyrus_content.env. In the TI OpenCode trial, genuine matching outputs exist in the publication checkout and assignment text attachments are byte-verified, but runtime hydration returns no text because it looks in the shared checkout. Reuse the existing root resolver; preserve the configured Biblicus directory. No tenant adoption, schema fallback, budget implementation, deployment or paid execution.

Feature: Selected publication root for newsroom runtime
  Scenario: Hydrate stored assignment text from the selected publication
    Given an explicit publication root with genuine storage configuration
    And stored brief and instructions for an assignment
    When the newsroom runtime reads assignment context
    Then it reads text from that publication storage
    And it uses the configured knowledge work directory
  Scenario: Preserve default root behavior
    Given no explicit publication root
    When the newsroom runtime starts
    Then it uses the existing content runtime root resolution

Scope: minimal constant binding correction and isolated regression tests; non-paid live verification using the existing TI records and outputs. Keep procedure disabled, preserve all draft versions and legacy data. No merges or deployments.
